paite: Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpin’n azak in solomon thuhaksa pipi a ettel tum in nungzui mi tampi toh sangawngsaute a gimlim leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua in Jerusalem ah ahohtou a: Solomon kiang atuntouh in, alungsim a om tengteng suahsiang vek in ahoupih hi.
heading: Sheba Kumpinu Hong Vehna / (1 Kum 10.1-13)
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

paite: Huan Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a: Solomon in adawn theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

paite: Huchi in Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pilna leh a-inn lam amuh in,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

paite: adohkan a nek dingte, asikhate tutdante, anasemte nasepdante, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite leh akivatdante uh, TOUPA' inn a hohtouhnate, alungmang hial hi.
english: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildan thuthang ka gam a ka zak adik mahmah ahi.
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

paite: Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen kia uh ka um thei kei a, ngai in, na pilna thupidan akimkhat leng ahon na hilh kei uh: na minthanna ka zakte nakpi in na khup hi.
english: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

paite: Na mite nak hamphat na uh e, hiai na sikha na kiang a om gige a na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete hampha hi na tel uh e!
english: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak, akumpipa ding a alaltutphah a hon tusakpa TOUPA na Pathian phat in om hen: na Pathian in Israelte tangtawn a hihkip ding in a-it a, huaiziak in diktattak a vaihawm ding in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Blessed be Yahweh your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for Yahweh your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim tampi mahmah leh suangmantamte apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang himhim a-om ngei kei hi.
english: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

paite: Huan Solomon sikhate leh Huram sikhate Ophir a kipan a dangka-eng va pote'n algum sing leh suangmantam ahon pua uhi.
english: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

paite: Kumpipa'n algum sing TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding leh lasa mite a ding a kaihging leh pekging ding in abawl a: huchibang Judah gam ah tuma lam in amu ngei kei uhi.
english: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

paite: Sheba kumpinu'n athil apiak sim louh in kumpipa Solomon in adeihdeih ape sam a, huchi in agam lam ah aheute toh apai nawnta uhi.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

paite: Huchi in Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng hong lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk buk ahi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Hauhsakna / (1 Kum 10.14-25)
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

paite: Mi ompolhte leh sumsin mite hon tawi sim het louh in: huan, Arabia kumpipa tengteng leh gam ukpate'n Solomon kiang ah dangka-engte, dangkasikte ahon tawi sek uhi.
english: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekthoh in lum lian chi zanih abawl a, lum lian khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk abei hi.
english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

paite: Dangka-eng sukpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat zel ah dangka-eng shekel zathum abei a; huaite Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n Saihapak laltutphah thupitak abawl behlap a, dangka siang ngen in aluan hi.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

paite: Laltutphah a akaltouhna siksan gukte, laltutphah toh azop, dangka-eng khe ngaknate, aban ngakna bul a ding humpinelkai lim nihte a-om hi.
english: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

paite: Siksan guk lang tuak tung ah humpinelkai sawm-le-nih adingh uhi. Huchibang koi lai gam ah leng abawl ngei kei uh.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon nou tengteng dangka-eng vek ahi a, Lebanon gammang inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng siang vek ahi; Solomon dam lai in dangkasik bangmah in asim kei uhi.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

paite: Kumpipa'n longhon, Huram sikhate, Tarshish a hohsek kikoppih anei a, kum thum hal zel in, Tarshish longhon in dangka-eng, dangkasik, saiha, zawng leh utongte, ahon po sek hi.
english: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung kumpipa tengteng hauhsakna leh pilna lam ah akhup vek hi.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in alungtang a akoih, apilna thu ngaikhe ding in, kumpipa tengteng in Solomon ahon zuan huthut uhi.
english: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

paite: Kum teng a piak bikhiah nei in dangkasik tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puante, galvante, gimlimte, sakolte, sabiltungte ape zel uhi.
english: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

paite: Huan Solomon in sakol leh kangtalai koihna mun sangli anei a, huan sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate ah, Jerusalem kumpipa kiangte ah a-omsak hi.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in lui a kipan a Philistia gam leh Aigupta gam tan a kumpipa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

paite: erusalem ah kumpipa'n dangkasikte suang bang mai a tam in a-omsak a, sidar singte phaizang a theipite bang lel a ngaih in a-omsak hi.
english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

paite: Solomon a ding in sakolte Aigupta a kipan leh gam chih a kipan in ahon la zel uhi.
english: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

paite: Solomon tanchin dangte abul a kipan atawp tanpha in, zawlnei Nathan gelh tanchinbu ah, Shilon mi Ahijah genkholhna bu ah, Nebat tapa Jeroboam tungtang thu a zawlnei Iddo mengmuh gelhna bu ah atuang kei maw?
heading: Solomon Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (1 Kum 11.41-43)
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

paite: Solomon in Jerusalem ah Israel mi tengteng tung ah kum sawmli vai ahawm hi.
english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

paite: Solomon bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apa David khua ah avui ua, asik in atapa Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
